description: Header file defining classes and structures for Microsoft symbol server conversion in Breakpad, including symbol info, GUID/signature handling, and symbol server operations.

classes.name: MissingSymbolInfo
classes.description: Contains information about a missing symbol file, including code and debug identifiers.

classes.name: GUIDOrSignatureIdentifier
classes.description: Handles GUID or signature identifiers used in symbol files.

classes.name: MSSymbolServerConverter
classes.description: Main class for locating and converting symbol files from Microsoft symbol servers.

methods.name: InitializeFromString
methods.description: Parses a debug identifier string into GUID or signature components.

methods.name: LocatePEFile
methods.description: Locates the PE (DLL or EXE) file based on symbol info.

methods.name: LocateSymbolFile
methods.description: Locates the symbol file (e.g., PDB) based on symbol info.

methods.name: LocateAndConvertSymbolFile
methods.description: Locates and converts the symbol file to Breakpad's dumped format.
